description: Mixed daily practice allocation. Original source files remain ID-contiguous; this map assigns original Question IDs to mixed daily sets.
source_files: data/question-markdown/part-01.md through part-21.md; source Question ID n is in part floor((n-1)/60)+1.
allocation_note: The source bank's domain inventory does not match the official SAT blueprint. Daily mixes are proportionally balanced to the available 1,234-question bank, not represented as exact official test weighting.
